sourceTitle: An Account of The Kingdom of Nepal And of the Territories Annexed to this Dominion by the House of Gorkha
description: "An Account of The Kingdom of Nepal" by Francis Buchanan Hamilton is a historical account written in the early 19th century. This work aims to provide a comprehensive description of Nepal, its geography, people, and customs, particularly in the context of the political landscape prior to the Anglo-Nepalese War.
